captions.detailed: A laser-range-finding binocular assembly featuring two long, slightly tapered cylindrical objective housings in a dark matte finish. A central prism block sits between the barrels, topped with a smaller rectangular button guard mechanism. The diopter ring on the eyepiece rotates continuously, and the top-mounted guard flips open on a revolute hinge.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated laser-range-finding binocular assembly in CadQuery. Ensure it features two fixed cylindrical objective housings, a central block, a continuously rotating diopter ring, and a top range button guard configured with a revolute joint.
captions.factory: The code defines an articulated object with four primary parts. First, the base frame is built using combined cylinders for the two main objective barrels and central prism housing. A diopter ring is modeled as a smaller concentric cylinder and attached via a continuous joint. Lastly, a top-mounted range button guard is constructed from box primitives and connected to the main body using a revolute joint.
